headline: Investcorp Private Equity Fund II files SEBI Reg 31(4) substantial acquisition disclosure for Nephrocare Health Services
sum: Investcorp Private Equity Fund II has filed a SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition in Nephrocare Health Services Limited, signalling a takeover or material shareholding increase in the Indian dialysis and nephrology care provider.
detail: The disclosure filed with the NSE under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 Regulation 31(4) indicates that Investcorp Private Equity Fund II has initiated a substantial shareholding or control acquisition in Nephrocare Health Services Limited. The timing (June 2026) and regulatory mechanism used suggest a structured acquisition likely subject to conditions precedent (regulatory clearances including CCI, FIPB if applicable, and SEBI approval of open offer if triggered). The specific acquisition value, percentage stake, and timing to completion are contained in the full disclosure document filed with the exchange.
